ocr.notes: headline misread ('WHAT PRIZE-FIGHT', 'Donkey il gent d'); it reads 'THAT PRIZE-FIGHT. Jem Coyne, Donkey Neary and Tom Allen All After Rooke.'

title.suggested: Allen Renews His Challenge to Rooke

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Arthur Chambers telegraphed Tom Allen that he had sent articles to Harry Hill's for Rooke to sign, for a fight within fifty miles of Detroit for $1,000 a side.

metadata.notes: masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Monday Morning, June 28, 1875

facts.fact: After the failed Rooke fight, Allen renewed his challenge: Arthur Chambers sent articles to Harry Hill's for Rooke to sign to fight Allen within fifty miles of Detroit for $1,000 a side

notes: The telegram is addressed to Tom Allen, 417 Washington avenue. Current title is wrong: the match is Allen's, not one between Chambers and Rooke. Jem Coyne also asked Allen to second him in a match with Rooke (skipped as minor).
